## Summary

Describe why this change is needed and what it changes.

## Verification

List the exact commands or manual checks you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change uses only public LitheView APIs.
- [ ] Tests or reproducible verification cover behavior changes.
- [ ] Documentation and examples are updated where needed.
- [ ] No binaries, generated output, secrets, or customer data are included.
- [ ] Every commit includes a `Signed-off-by` line (`git commit -s`).
